body: Running git bisect on alma8-gcc9-release, compilation failure was introduced commit 5d1f26b0acb7200edfff686d981165e9c1c99375.

The code in that commit matches https://www.postgresql.org/message-id/25875.1565275667%40sss.pgh.pa.us (Re: PG_TRY()/CATCH() in a loop reports uninitialized variables):

> I'd be inclined to say "so don't do that then".

cc: @andrei-mart

body:
The issue is much older than https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/5d1f26b0acb7200edfff686d981165e9c1c99375,
the problem there is PG_TRY/PG_CATCH block used in a loop, and it has been in a loop since https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/commit/3212616e351647436f808d4963d229e7881996c8
Can we move the loop body to a separate function?
But let's do that after we see if this error goes away with GCC 10 or newer.
